Context: 2. Orders applicable for HRA.-

11. During Temporary Transfer.-Admissible up to 90 days at the rates applicable at the old station and beyond this period at the rates applicable for the new station. - Para. 4.9.
12. During deputation abroad.Admissible at the rates applicable to headquarters. Allowances can be drawn on furnishing certificate if family resides at headquarters. - Para. 6.3.
